name: Denta
long_description:
Denta saves companies money and time on dental insurance. In two minutes, employers can sign up directly, without dealing with the middlemen who add 25% to the cost.

I started Denta after building software for my dad's 10 dental practices. In scaling that software business to 16k MRR in 10 weeks, I realized I was working on a small problem in dentistry. Existing software sucks, no doubt, but what dentists complain about even more: insurance.

Dental Insurance Companies collect $100B/year in premiums. 25% of that is wasted on administrators, brokers, and c-suite salaries. As the son of a dentist, I will not let these companies burn $25B/year anymore. That money should go to dentists via reimbursements, patients via more coverage, and employers via reduced costs.
